category_title: Credit recovery students with self-discipline and engagement challenges
minimal_context: The student is logging into the NovaNET online courseware to complete a reading assignment during a summer credit recovery session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please log into the NovaNET online courseware and begin the reading assignment for today's summer session.

STUDENT: I'm logged in, but I'm already having difficulties with the amount of reading demanded of us here. It's just walls of text.

TUTOR: Just do your best to read through the material.

STUDENT: I can't focus on all this. Before this summer, I didn’t pay much attention and had messed up priorities, so I'm not used to reading this much on my own.

TUTOR: If you get stuck on a section, you can just ask me a question about it.

STUDENT: I'm not going to keep asking questions about every single page. I'm just going to skip the reading and guess. Usually I'd just avoid this by being distracted, by my friends, or sleeping in class.

options.A: Identify one or two specific behavior targets on an action plan and provide a reward for achieving them at the end of each session.
options.B: Self-monitor specific praise and deliver it on a 2-minute fixed interval schedule using a praise self-monitoring form with ten 2-minute intervals.
options.C: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the online reading assignments during the summer session.
options.D: Incorporate a variety of media and interactive tools (videos, Gizmos, SAS activities) to move beyond traditional text-heavy online courseware.
